flashcard_questions.q: Nutrients needed in large amounts by the body — protein, carbohydrates, and fat.
A macronutrient that provides the most concentrated source of energy at 9 kcal per gram. Also called lipids.
The scientific term for fats and oils — fats are solid at room temperature, oils are liquid.

flashcard_questions.a: A covalent bond where two atoms share two pairs of electrons — in fatty acids, double bonds between carbon atoms determine whether a fat is saturated or unsaturated.
A type of fat with no double bonds between carbon atoms in its fatty acid chains — solid at room temperature and linked to raised cholesterol.
